description: Answers 'any new announcements?' Lists the latest news forum posts with subject, course name and text, up to 5 posts from each of up to 10 news forums. A course or forum the school server will not open is left out and the rest still shows. Input: course_ids, an optional array of course IDs to limit the search; leave it out to cover all current courses. Ask: 'Any new announcements from my teachers?'

items.description: Moodle course ID. Use get_my_courses to find it.

name: get_announcements
title: Announcements
